about:
Southwest Decoratives & Kokopelli Quilting Company operates from Bernalillo, New Mexico, where it has been based since relocating from Albuquerque. The business was founded in 1992 by Mary-Jo McCarthy as a home-based venture selling Southwestern-themed quilt patterns through a small black-and-white catalog. It remains family-owned, with McCarthy and her family running the operation.

The company retails a curated selection of Southwestern-style fabrics, quilt patterns, kits, and notions for quilting, sewing, cross stitch, and general crafting. After launching an e-commerce site in 1994, it opened a 2,500-square-foot brick-and-mortar shop in 2001. The store moved to its current location on US Highway 550 in Bernalillo, where it also serves wholesale buyers. Inventory includes cotton prints, block-of-the-month programs, clothing patterns, and craft supplies.

Customers include individual quilters, sewists, and crafters across the United States, Canada, and Europe, as well as other retail shops purchasing wholesale. The shop attracted national recognition in 2013 when Better Homes & Gardens Quilt Sampler Magazine named it a Top 10 quilt shop.

The founding mission was to share the enchantment of Southwest culture with the sewing and crafting community. The company emphasizes access to distinctive regional designs and competitive pricing on quality fabrics, patterns, and kits.
